items: Mexico has more people than Venezuela.
A library has more books than a bookcase.
A forest has more trees than a garden.
There are more mountains in the Andes than in a valley.
There are more accidents in a city than in the country.

items.q: Does Mexico have more people than Venezuela?
Does Venezuela have more people than Mexico?
Which country has more people than Venezuela?
Does a library have more books than a bookcase?
Which has more books a library or a bookcase?
Are there more accidents in the country than in a city?
Are there more mountains in a valley than in Los Andes?
Does a garden have more trees than a forest?

items: An apartment has fewer rooms than a house.
A modern family has fewer children than an old fashioned family.
A lazy person has fewer opportunities than an active person.
There are fewer diseases in an urban area than in the rural area.
There are fewer schools in the country than in the city.

blocks.text: Make questions from the previous sentences.

lines: 1. An orchid is more beautiful than a rose.
2. *An open minded person is more intelligent than a close minded person.*
3. An athlete is more ingenious than a passive person.
4. A mature person is more patient than an immature one.
5. A child is more sincere than an adult.

blocks.text: Answer the questions according to the sentences above.

items.q: Which is more beautiful a rose or an orchid?
Who is more sincere an adult or a child?
Is a passive person more ingenious than an athlete?
Is an open-minded person more intelligent than a closed minded person?
Who is more patient a mature or immature person?
